name: Ravi
label: Ad-free premium loyalist
who: I have paid for Spotify Premium for years and use it daily, mostly to avoid ads, download music for offline listening, and cast to my devices. I care about having a clean listening experience and about features the free tier does not include.
value_for_money: Sees Premium as excellent value, saying it gives more value than their other streaming subscriptions combined, while describing the free version as restrictive and nearly unusable.
loyalty: Ad-free listening, offline downloads, and casting keep them on Premium; they say they would keep Spotify Premium longest if they had to cut subscriptions, and that a poor app experience makes them less willing to pay.
pain_points: Pop-ups and promoted content appear even for Premium users
Spotify pushes suggestions they did not ask for
Premium features are hard to find or were removed
Frequent UX changes make the app worse
tone: Enthusiastic and matter-of-fact about Premium, with frustration aimed at the free tier and recent app changes.
